sloka: तच्छ्रुत्वा भरतेनोक्तं दृष्ट्वा चापि ह्यधोमुखान् ।पौरान्दुःखेन सन्तप्तान्वसिष्ठो वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।। ७.१०७.९ ॥
transliteration: tacchrutvā bharatenoktaṁ dṛṣṭvā cāpi hyadhomukhān ।paurānduḥkhena santaptānvasiṣṭho vākyamabravīt ।। 7.107.9 ॥

translations.english: Having heard what Bharata said and seeing the citizens distressed and downcast with sorrow, Vasishtha spoke these words.
